summary: Ask-about-this-passage: chunk page button that opens chat pre-scoped to the text/passage
description: Close the funnel loop. Today it runs one direction: chat → citation → reader. This adds the return path: a button on every chunk page that opens /chat pre-scoped to that text (scope presets already support text/tradition scoping) with the passage as context, e.g. /chat?scope=<text_id>&about=<chunk_id>. An SEO visitor landing on one of the ~5,000 indexed chunk pages is then one click from the product. Anonymous visitors hit the normal sign-in flow with the intent preserved. Highest product value per line of code of the post-reader ideas.
